extension.description:
Watch ATP tour replays, highlights and features from your Tennis TV subscription.
Subscription required. Requires script.module.slyguy (installed automatically from the NERV Repository) and Kodi 20 or newer.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release for the StreamAMG-based Tennis TV platform - Sign in with a code or QR code, with the QR generated on the device - Live matches and channels, replays, highlights and features, browsable by tournament, player, category and year, plus search and your watchlist - Join Live, From Start or Resume for live matches that have already started - Match Info overlay during playback, synced to the video: live score, match and set stats, insights, head to head, key moments and the tournament draw
